notes: Turning on Claude Code now either works or says why it did not. The switch could report success while registering nothing, so Claude's developer settings said no servers were added while the switch sat on. Your Kit now checks with Claude itself that the connection actually landed before it claims anything, and a connection that did not take fails loudly with the reason instead of smiling through it.

Your Kit also finds the Claude command-line tool where it actually installs these days, so the connection is made the proper way, through Claude's own registration, on machines where it used to fall back to a second-best route.
